scope: M0: pre-assignment sample, not an M1 or M2 delivery

decisions.decision: Calculate CG and inertia from Onshape CAD; incorporate an added mass using a weighted average and the parallel-axis theorem.
decisions.why: Make the calculation repeatable before all design details are finalized. The note proposes an Octave script.
decisions.limit: The source omits fasteners, cables, and connectors. These results do not establish the measured mass of the dev kit, and this review did not validate the script.

decisions.decision: Select the integrated Hobbywing XRotor X6 Plus propulsion assembly.
decisions.replaced: Alternatives compared in the table; replacement of already-installed hardware is not established.
decisions.why: The report comparison favors cost, thrust, and weight, while reducing installation work.
decisions.limit: This is a documented historical selection. It does not establish the exact variant or inventory installed in October 2026.

decisions.decision: Use EURO connectors on the main PCB.
decisions.replaced: The connector used before PT2 is not identified.
decisions.why: Improve maintainability, according to the PT2 feature list.
decisions.limit: Explicitly superseded by Phoenix connectors in PT3: see D-005. This does not imply that every PT2 board was withdrawn.

decisions.decision: Separate precharge triggered by the main switch from SSR activation through radio control and the flight controller GPIO.
decisions.replaced: No preceding architecture is documented in this passage.
decisions.why: Limit inrush current before the SSR closes, and allow motor power to be cut through remote control.
decisions.limit: This describes an architecture, not a safety test performed by this review. PT3 retains precharge and SSR control; the exact implementation requires the applicable schematic revision.

decisions.decision: Replace Euro-style terminals with Phoenix connectors on the main PCB.
decisions.why: The report attributes the change to faster prototyping and more reliable field connections.
decisions.limit: The rationale is attributed to the report; this review does not claim a quantified reliability improvement.

decisions.decision: Position the GNSS approximately 2 cm above the FCU enclosure using an arch bracket, separated from the PCB.
decisions.replaced: A new bracket is introduced; the exact previous position is not identified here.
decisions.why: Reduce electromagnetic interference and support the receiver without direct contact with the FCU or PCB.
decisions.limit: This is a design intention. Comparable EMI measurements are missing, so it cannot establish that the interference problem was resolved.

decisions.decision: Mount attachment interfaces on 3 cm extenders.
decisions.replaced: Clearance from the airframe is added; the note does not specify every earlier mount.
decisions.why: Improve access when removing and replacing mission equipment.
decisions.limit: The dimension is explicitly documented. It does not establish compatibility with every attachment.

decisions.decision: Extend the lower arm screw holes through the battery walls and add access cutouts.
decisions.replaced: Earlier access between the middle plate and battery wall through chamfered holes.
decisions.why: The screws were difficult to replace; the cutouts allow access with an Allen key.
decisions.limit: This is a documented maintainability change. No assembly time was measured and no physical unit was inspected during this review.

decisions.decision: Secure the main PCB to a 3D-printed interface mounted on rubber dampers.
decisions.replaced: The note does not identify a specific earlier mount.
decisions.why: Reduce transmission of high-frequency vibration from the frame to the PCB and flight-controller sensors.
decisions.limit: The source labels the note Valid. It provides no measured attenuation values here; vibration reduction remains an objective rather than a result certified by this review.

decisions.decision: Record the Pelican 1640 case and PE foam while leaving the contradictory Nanuk reference in the same note unresolved.
decisions.replaced: The embedded proposal names Nanuk; the implementation summary names Pelican 1640.
decisions.why: Transport the drone and accessories with retention and protection.
decisions.limit: This submission does not resolve the discrepancy by inference. The model/BOM needs confirmation before the earlier proposal can be marked as superseded.
